name: Goblin Lockpicks
summary: A Venture Co. contact offers explosives for getting past Shadowfang’s gate, but asks you to find a work order first. Another Venture Co. worker nearby should be carrying one.

sections.title: A Work Order
sections.body: A Venture Co. contact hears that you plan to enter Shadowfang alone. Explosives could get you past the gate, but the contact needs a work order to make the supplies look proper in the company books. One of the other Venture Co. workers nearby should have the document.

faq.q: Why do they need a work order?
faq.answer: The Venture Co. contact needs a work order to make the explosives look legitimate in the company books.
The explosives are meant to get you past Shadowfang’s gate.

faq.q: Who might have the work order?
faq.answer: Another Venture Co. worker nearby should be carrying a work order.

faq.q: Am I going into Shadowfang alone?
faq.answer: The Venture Co. contact understands that you plan to enter Shadowfang alone.
